project.note: Not yet independently audited in VLA-Radar.

code.note: openpi currently supports π0.5 training and inference with the flow-matching head.

weights.note: π0.5 base, LIBERO and DROID checkpoints are publicly listed in openpi.

dataset.note: LIBERO/DROID examples and conversions are public, but the complete 10k+ hour base pretraining mixture is not packaged as a public project dataset.

training.note: openpi provides π0.5 fine-tuning configs and runnable training instructions.

inference.note: π0.5 checkpoints have public inference and policy-server examples.

evaluation.note: The repository documents π0.5 LIBERO evaluation and additional robot examples.

license.note: Repository code is Apache-2.0; model/base components include additional third-party license terms.
